data.name: Holds_pocket
data.value: What reaches you over the year: your net pay and net dividend, and what the company pays you besides pay, less any tax on it.

data.name: Holds_taxes_on_pay
data.value: What leaves your pay: your social contributions, the income tax and the municipal surcharge, less the tax credit for low earned income, and any advance-payment surcharge less its bonus.

data.name: Holds_taxes_on_pay_and_rent
data.value: What leaves your pay and the rent taxed with it: your social contributions, the income tax and the municipal surcharge, less the tax credit for low earned income, and any advance-payment surcharge less its bonus.

data.name: Holds_taxes_on_profit
data.value: What leaves the company's profit: the corporate tax and its advance-payment surcharge, and the tax withheld on your dividend, less what comes back on its exempt part.

data.name: Holds_kept_in_company
data.value: What stays in the company at year end: the profit after tax, with what it kept from earlier years, that is not paid out as a dividend.
